lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows along the visible lateral flank. The spacing between centroids increases slightly in the posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs, particularly in the mid-flank region, forming a non-perfect grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent linear feature is visible running horizontally across the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant semi-circular indentation or notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin, indicating an acquired structural anomaly.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least four Echeneidae individuals (remoras) positioned near the pectoral fin and along the ventral-lateral silhouette.
